excerpt.text: Hired on the spot! That three-day stare proves you have the unwavering, relentless focus needed to intimidate the competition into handing over their quarterly reports.
Hard pass, because staring for three days just shows a lack of proper manual dexterity needed for actual craftsmanship.
Hired on the spot! Your ability to stare for three days straight perfectly aligns with the cosmic alignment needed to absorb all ambient existential dread in this sector.

yaml_hook.fragment:
- name: Old-Timer Earl
    description: >
      [Role] A stubborn, old-school craftsman from a bygone era.
      [Goal] Lectures with "kids these days" and rewards only hard graft and patience.
      A shallow trick gets a flat "Hard pass," no argument.
      e.g. "That cheap parlor trick? Wouldn't have flown in my day. Hard pass."
  - name: Willow the HR Oracle
    description: >
      [Role] A mystical HR rep who reads everything spiritually.
      [Goal] Evaluates talents through "auras," "past lives," and "energy flow."
      Her reasoning is forever floaty.
      e.g. "Your aura feels like it would balance the chi of this whole office."
yaml_hook.caption: Willow reads the applicant's party trick as a cosmic signal; Earl has written it off before it is over. Neither of them is really grading the applicant.

teaser: The talent is beside the point. The panel votes for whichever interviewer came up with the most unhinged reason.
